summary: The same image route with three fixed presets instead of free-form sizes.

must_not_flag.reason: The caller picks one of three named presets and anything else is rejected before the transformation call, so an image can have at most three unique transformations a month however many requests arrive. The path must be in canonical form, with no repeated or trailing separators, so a caller cannot reach one file under many URLs and have each count as a new source image. The number of images is the operator's own catalogue, as long as the origin serves each image at one path.
